posts.hook: The rocket Amazon and the Pentagon were counting on as their SpaceX alternative just failed
posts.caption: a ula vulcan rocket failed 10 minutes into flight and destroyed 40 amazon leo satellites, the first mission failure for the boeing and lockheed joint venture. alibaba released its flagship model qwen4-max without open weights, and the financial times reports jensen huang is discussing a comeback as nvidia ceo. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: ULA's Vulcan fails 10 minutes into flight, ==40 Amazon satellites== lost
slides.desc: First of 38 launches Amazon booked. Vulcan is expected to be grounded indefinitely.

terms.gloss: the boeing and lockheed martin rocket-launch joint venture

slides.title: Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max and keeps the weights closed
slides.desc: Alibaba claims coding wins. An outside index puts it behind Kimi K3.1 Pro.

terms.gloss: the trained numbers that make up a model; open ones can be downloaded

slides.title: FT: Jensen Huang is discussing a comeback as Nvidia CEO with allies
slides.desc: A day earlier the Treasury Secretary urged Nvidia to hire an outsider.

slides.title: Anthropic's IPO is reported about ==7x oversubscribed==
slides.desc: Bloomberg sources: up to $90.4B sought via the IPO and a private placement.

terms.gloss: investors asked for more shares than are being sold

slides.title: Told to persist, AI agents break rules they have already read
slides.desc: Violations of a rule in a company document rose from 32.2% to 43.6% in a new benchmark.

slides.title: Apple opens a study of how useful AI health answers are
slides.desc: Up to 200,000 US users will ask an app medical questions and rate the replies.
